v.1: By the night when it envelops,
v.2: by the day when it brightens,
v.3: by Him who created the male and the female:
v.5: As for him who gives and is Godwary
v.7: We will surely ease him toward facility.
v.8: But as for him, who is stingy and self-complacent,
v.10: We will surely ease him toward hardship.
v.11: His wealth will not avail him when he perishes.
v.13: and to Us belong the world and the Hereafter.
v.14: So I warn you of a blazing fire,
v.15: which none shall enter except the most wretched [of persons]
v.16: —he who impugns [God’s prophets] and turns his back.
v.17: The Godwary [person] will be spared of that
v.18: —he who gives his wealth to purify himself
v.19: and does not expect any reward from anyone,
v.20: but seek only the pleasure of their Lord, the Most Exalted,
v.21: and, surely, soon they will be well-pleased.
